column1: # Term-level roles: (source, id, canonical formula) -> role, where the record says it but the tokeniser cannot
# read it. Record ids, formulas and labels only, no text from papers. role: precursor | not_observed | printed_as;
# every role keeps the token out of groups. A row whose record is present but has no such formula token stops

column5: the plural label 'precursors inferred' after the list covers this token too; the value names 353 as the mono-CQA precursor marker
